response.sql: WITH tally AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), 'missing') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), 'missing')), shares AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM tally), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.hand, s.n, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(above.n) AS combined_tally, AVG(above.share) AS avg_share, AVG(above.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM above, avg_share a;
